text:
Ivy Morgan: Heads-up team — legal approved a small policy clarification that we need to announce tomorrow AM to customers and press: update to data retention for sandbox API keys (30 -> 14 days). Need copy and timing.

Riley Park: Ack. Is this urgent because of compliance or storage?

Ivy Morgan: Compliance + customer feedback. We want to be transparent; no user data deletion, just shorter retention for ephemeral sandbox keys.

Noah Kim: Draft angle: "Policy update: sandbox key retention shortened to 14 days to improve privacy controls". Keep it concise in the blog and a single-line note on the status page.

Elena Soto: I'll draft the blog post and the customer email. Quick Q: do we need to notify paid Dedicated/Private customers differently?

LegalBot: Yes. Use the enterprise addendum language. Must include: reason for change, effective date, steps for customers to retrieve logs, and contact for support. Clearance ETA 45m.

Ivy Morgan: Good. PressOps  plan for a short blog + email to users at 09:00 PT, press advisory at 09:15 PT linking to the blog and a one-paragraph explainers for tech press. No embargo.

PressOps Bot: Scheduled blog publish at 2026-08-10T09:00:00-07:00 and press advisory at 2026-08-10T09:15:00-07:00. Will prepare outbound list: TechCrunch, The Register, The Information.

Riley Park: Social plan? Probably just a neutral tweet pointing to blog. No hot takes.

Elena Soto: Draft email done (short): "We're updating sandbox key retention to 14 days starting Aug 10 to enhance privacy for short-lived testing keys. No action required for production keys. See details: https://go.redwood/sandbox-retention". Posting to doc now.

Noah Kim: Add an FAQ item: "Will my production keys be affected?" answer: "No." Also include support contact and a short script for CSMs.

Ivy Morgan: CSM script: "If customer asks, explain change improves privacy for ephemeral keys; production unaffected; we can export logs on request within retention windows." Keep it under two sentences.

LegalBot: Reviewed blog draft. Suggest swapping "privacy" for "data minimization" in headline. Also include effective date in H1.

Elena Soto: Updated headline to: "Policy update: sandbox key retention shortened to 14 days (effective Aug 10, 2026)". Blog draft uploaded: https://go.redwood/drafts/sandbox-retention-2026

PressOps Bot: Outbound advisory template ready. Will include optional exec quote placeholder. Do we want a quote?

Ivy Morgan: Exec quote optional. If we add one, keep it high-level: focus on user protection and developer productivity. Legal to approve.

Riley Park: Scheduling social: tweet at 09:05 PT with link and pinned thread with FAQ. LinkedIn short post at 09:10 PT for product audience.

Noah Kim: Support FYI: tagging @support in doc and will add canned response snippets.

Elena Soto: Done. Canned support snippets in doc and CSM script added.

PressOps Bot: Final checklist: blog published, email sent, press advisory sent, social posted, support snippets live. I'll run the checklist at publish time. :white_check_mark:

Ivy Morgan: Perfect. If Legal lifts any content restrictions, flag here immediately. Otherwise we'll publish at 09:00 PT tomorrow.

LegalBot: No further changes at this time. Clearance complete.
